sections.heading: Company profile
sections.body:
D&K manufactures a wide range of lamination and encapsulation machines and films, including SuperStick® for digital output, serving printers and print finishers.

Industry: Manufacturing · Size: not published · Products: Lamination Machines, Encapsulation Equipment, Wide Format Equipment, Picture Framing Equipment, Digital Foiling Machine, SuperStick® Film

sections.heading: Qualification summary
sections.body: D&K Europe scores 8 of 100 (tier disqualified) at 85% confidence. The score is carried by event engagement (8/15). Nothing was found for industry fit, application fit, company size and pain-point alignment, so those score zero rather than being estimated.

sections.heading: Tedlar angle
sections.body: No durability claims were found in their public copy, so the opening has to establish the problem before the product. Lead with the cost of premature graphic failure rather than with film chemistry.

sections.heading: Comparable accounts
sections.body: Closest known-good accounts: ORAFOL Europe (16% similar on films, digital, website, wide); Drytac (16% similar on films, print, film, wide); Mactac (16% similar on films, digital, print, film). Reference the comparable account by name on the call — a converter is far more persuaded by what a peer does than by a spec sheet.

sections.heading: Who to talk to
sections.body: No decision-maker resolved from public sources. Target titles for this ICP: VP Product, VP Product Development, VP Innovation, VP Research and Development, Director of R&D.

sections.heading: Gaps and risks
sections.body:
• Industry fit: 3 more core category terms in its positioning would reach the ceiling.
• Application fit: 4 more application area(s) would reach the ceiling.
• Company size: Any published revenue or headcount would unlock up to 15 points.
• Pain-point alignment: Each additional durability theme found adds 5 points.
• Flags on the record: size unknown
